messages:
olivia: Kicking off 3-phase geo rollout for release v2.3.0. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Deploy window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Deploy bot queued.

deploy-bot: @channel Starting deploy v2.3.0 -> service/redwood-inference (canary strategy: 5% -> 25% -> 100%). Canary config: us-west1 5% first.

maya: quick check — do we have the warm-pool reserved for EU? last time warm-up lagged and we hit OOMs.

raj: EU warm-pool target set to 40 instances, autoscaler policy TTL 180s. But current active = 29, desired = 40 (scaling in progress).

jamal: can we hold EU until autoscaler finishes? suggest US go ahead, let EU remain pinned to 2.2.8 fallback until warm capacity achieved.

olivia: agree. US can start. EU pin fallback = v2.2.8 if the canary shows regressions or capacity < 95% of target.

deploy-bot: US canary rollout started. Smoke tests running. Logs:
```
[deploy-bot] smoke: 10/10 checks passed
[metrics] p95 latency (prompt): 540ms
[metrics] cpu_util: 28% gpu_mem: 62%
```

leo: ONCALL-EU here — autoscaler at 60% progress, estimated 4m to desired pool. watching any queue build.

maya: set rollback triggers: error-rate increase > 2% sustained 5m OR p95 latency > 1s sustained 5m. If triggered, immediate pin to v2.2.8 and route 100% to fallback.

jamal: canary ramp plan: US 5% -> 25% after 10m green -> 100% after 30m. EU hold at 0% until warm-pool >= 95%. APAC blocked until EU completes.

deploy-bot: US canary 5% -> 25% complete. No adverse signals.

olivia: good. @leo please confirm when EU pool hits 95% so we can start EU canary at 5%. Also drop a note in this thread before starting APAC.

leo: EU warm-pool now at 38/40 (95%). ready to start canary in 2m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: EU canary queued — will apply 5% slice in eu-west1. Canary smoke will run same checks as US.

maya: reminder — route pin policy applied: if EU fails, traffic auto-reroutes to US-dominant endpoint for 15m while we investigate. Logs of reroute are retained.

deploy-bot: EU canary smoke: 9/10 checks passed (one transient model load warn). metrics:
```
[metrics] p95 latency: 880ms
[metrics] error_rate: 0.6%
[deploy-bot] note: queued model load warnings xfer; attempting retry
```

raj: that model-load warn is expected during first warm spin. if it clears in 3 retries ok.

olivia: hold on APAC until EU clears. Jamal — prep APAC routing table and pin fallback.

jamal: on it. APAC fallback will route to nearest warm region (us-west) and mark sticky for 10m to reduce cross-region replay.

deploy-bot: EU canary stable for 12m. No rollback triggers hit. progressing to 25% per plan.

sarah: adding release notes snippet here for customer-facing doc: "v2.3.0: improved KV cache stability, reduced tail latency for long-context prompts, opt-in quantization profiles. See internal changelog: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.0"

olivia: final checks before full rollout: 1) US 30m green ✅ 2) EU 20m green ✅ 3) APAC warm pool verified and routing ready ✅ — if all good, proceed to 100% across regions.

deploy-bot: US -> EU -> APAC final ramp started. APAC warm-pool present (20/20), starting 5% canary in ap-southeast1.

leo: watching EU metrics, nothing unusual.

maya: ops checklist complete. Rollback playbook ready and pinned artifacts uploaded.

deploy-bot: APAC smoke pass. Final ramp to 100% complete across all targeted regions. Rollout finished without automated rollback.

olivia: huge thanks all. Postmortem: follow-up items — tighten autoscaler ramp and reduce model load retries on initial warm spin. I will send PR for warm-pool tuning. :rocket:
